animationStyle.Name: Movement animation
animationStyle.Hint: How tokens look while they move. Hop bounces from space to space like a playing piece; Glide lifts once, slides, and sets down at the end. Only changes what you see.

liftHeight.Name: Lift height
liftHeight.Hint: How high a moving token rises, as a fraction of one grid space.

liftScale.Name: Lift zoom
liftScale.Hint: How much a token grows at the top of its lift, which is what sells the sense of height. 0 disables it.

stepSounds.Name: Step sounds
stepSounds.Hint: Play a sound each time a moving token you can see lands on a space: a footstep, or for a horse the next stride of a gallop. A winged creature is heard flapping while its movement action is Fly. Untick to turn the sounds off for yourself. They play on Foundry's Interface audio channel.

stepVolume.Name: Step sound volume
stepVolume.Hint: Multiplied by the Interface volume slider in Foundry's audio settings.

stepSoundSet.Name: Step sound
stepSoundSet.Hint: Which footsteps you hear. Match the token picks a set for each token. A creature named as a horse or another hoofed animal gets hoofbeats. Anything else goes by its armor: cloth for unarmored, leather for light, leather and mail for medium, plate for heavy. The armor is read from the actor in D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e and Starfinder 2e, and a GM can set the sound for any token in Token Configuration. The other choices use one set for every token.

stepWeight.Name: Big creatures sound big
stepWeight.Hint: Steps from a token two or more spaces across are played lower, with more bass, and ring in the room after they land: a little for Large, more for Huge, most for Gargantuan. It goes by the size of the token, so it works in any game system and with any step sound. Hoofbeats and wingbeats are recordings of something Large already, so they change from Huge up. Untick to hear every token the same.

stepSound.Name: Custom step sound
stepSound.Hint: An audio file to play for every step instead of the built-in sounds. Leave blank for the built-in sounds.

rangeOverlay.Name: Show reachable spaces
rangeOverlay.Hint: While you drag a token, paint the spaces it can reach on the grid. Square and hex grids only.

rangeColor.Name: Movement colour
rangeColor.Hint: Colour of the spaces within the token's normal speed. Used with My own colours.

dashColor.Name: Second band colour
dashColor.Hint: Colour of the next band out: a dash in D&D, a second Stride in Pathfinder.

rangeOpacity.Name: Overlay opacity
rangeOpacity.Hint: How strongly the reachable spaces are tinted.

speedPath.Name: Speed data path
speedPath.Hint: Where on the actor a token's speed is stored, for example system.attributes.movement.{action}. {action} is replaced by the token's current movement action (walk, fly, swim…). Leave blank to use the built-in preset for this game system.

speedUnit.Name: Speed is measured in
speedUnit.Hint: Only applies to a custom speed data path. Choose Grid spaces for systems that store speed as a number of squares or hexes.

defaultSpeed.Name: Fallback speed
defaultSpeed.Hint: Speed in scene distance units for tokens whose speed cannot be found, including tokens with no actor. 0 draws no range for them.

subtractUsed.Name: Subtract movement already used
subtractUsed.Hint: In combat, shrink the range by what the token has already moved this turn, using Foundry's movement history.

combatOnly.Name: Only show range in combat
combatOnly.Hint: Hide the reachable spaces for tokens that are not in an active combat.

maxSpaces.Name: Largest range to draw
maxSpaces.Hint: Cap, in grid spaces, on how far the range is searched. Very fast tokens are clipped to this so a drag never stalls.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Log speed lookups and range timings to the console.

farColor.Name: Further band colour
farColor.Hint: Colour of the third band and any beyond it.

rangeBands.Name: Range bands
rangeBands.Hint: Multiples of the token's speed to draw, separated by commas: "1, 2" is a move and a dash, "1, 2, 3" is three Strides, "1" is the move alone. Leave blank for this game system's default.

colorScheme.Name: Colour scheme
colorScheme.Hint: Suit the game system: Pathfinder and Starfinder 2e get green, yellow and red for the first, second and third Stride; every other system matches your Character HUD. Match my Character HUD takes the colour from the device you wear in Scorpious187's Sci-Fi Character HUD: in the Tiles style the whole range is that device's main colour, bold nearest the token, and darker and fainter with each band further out; in the Flat style the bands use the device's main, accent and warning colours. If the HUD is not active, or you choose My own colours, the three colours below are used as they are.

walkSpeed.Name: Walk speed
walkSpeed.Hint: How fast tokens travel across the map, in grid spaces per second, for everyone. Foundry's own speed is 6. Each movement action keeps its usual pace relative to this, so swimming and crawling stay at half speed. This is how the move is animated, not how far a token can go.

pathfinding.Name: Find a way round
pathfinding.Hint: When the straight route to where you are dragging is blocked, plan the cheapest route round instead of stopping at the obstacle; and when it crosses something that costs extra movement, take a cheaper route if there is one. Turn this off if another module does your pathfinding.

overlayStyle.Name: Range style
overlayStyle.Hint: Tiles draws each reachable space as its own rounded tile, with a soft glowing edge round the whole area. Flat is a plain tint with a hard outline per band.

overlayMotion.Name: Animate the range
overlayMotion.Hint: With the Tiles style, the edge of the range pulses gently and a slow shimmer crosses it. Untick for a still overlay.

routeMarkers.Name: Light up the route
routeMarkers.Hint: With the Tiles style, routes are drawn as a lit strip with a ring on every step, in place of Foundry's line and squares: the route you are dragging, and the trail a token follows as it walks, which dims behind it. Each stretch is in the colour of the band it falls in, so you can see where the move ends and the dash begins. The distance label stays. Untick to keep Foundry's own ruler.

armor.Label: Step sound
armor.Hint: What this token's steps sound like. Go by the creature gives hoofbeats to anything named as a horse or another hoofed animal, reads the armor the actor wears where the game system has it, and is unarmored otherwise.

flight.Label: Flight sound
flight.Hint: What this token sounds like while its movement action is Fly. Go by the creature gives wingbeats to anything named as a dragon, a bird or another winged animal, and nothing to the rest. On the ground it makes its step sound, wings or no wings.

toggleRange.Name: Show movement range
toggleRange.Hint: Pin or unpin the reachable spaces for the selected token without dragging it.

followMe.Name: Bring players' view along (hold)
followMe.Hint: GM only. Hold while moving tokens and every player's view pans to follow that move. Players' own movement never moves anyone else's view.

Notify.NoSpeed: Token Movement could not find a speed for this token, so no range is drawn. Set a speed data path or a fallback speed in the module settings.
Notify.Clipped: This token's range is larger than the configured maximum and has been clipped.
